name: skillevaluator
capabilities: Tier 1 pinned CI scanner on local Docker
Tier 2 catalog and deduplication with an authorized provider
Tier 3 strict validation and Harbor 0.25.0 paired benchmarks
smoke: Validate a synthetic Tier 3 dataset in strict mode, inspect the installed Harbor and evaluator versions, and run the qualified Tier 1 controls when Docker is available. Live deduplication and paired evaluation require separate provider authorization.
rollback: Select the previous qualified environment and evaluator image. Keep the provider/model identities, datasets and retained result digests with their original runs before changing pins.
